name: project_brandings
description: Per-project appearance: the name, the logo and the HumHub space a member registering through that project is put into.

columns.name: alias
columns.description: The short name a link carries — the project is looked up by this, not by id. Unique.

columns.name: space_id
columns.note: A HumHub space id, external to gradido. It is not a gradido row identifier and stays uint32 — see contracts/AGENTS.md on names ending in _id.

columns.name: new_user_to_space
columns.description: Whether a member registering through this project is added to the space.

notes: No created_at, no updated_at. Legacy never added them and nothing reads them; gradido2 adding them is a schema decision, not a repair.
The banner route is public — projectBranding.getBanner needs no session, because a logo is shown before anybody has logged in. See server/backend/project-branding.json.
space_id and space_url point at HumHub, which is a foreign system. A row whose space no longer exists is a normal state and must not fail the read.
